_about: E4 explore harness fixtures (S295, 2026-09-02). Same fictional workshop
world as fixtures.json — the memories are loaded from there, only the
queries live here. Explore mode is the serendipity lens: it must surface
the ADJACENT memory (on-topic, one step sideways, rarely recalled) that a
best-match ranker buries. So explore cannot be scored by best-match-first;
that would collapse it into focus.
Each query names: expected (the bullseye ids focus should serve — not
credited to explore), adjacent (the ADJACENCY SET: curated from the
world's ground truth, i.e. what a person who knows the world would call
'related, not the answer' — labelled BEFORE any explore output was read,
per doctrine-probe-for-the-answer), ok (on-topic neighbours that earn no
credit but are not noise). Everything else served is noise.
Per query, with E = explore@5 and F = focus@5 on the same prompt:
adj_recall  = |E ∩ adjacent| / |adjacent|
adj_rr      = 1 / rank in E of the first adjacent id (0 if none)
differential= |(E ∩ adjacent) − F|   — adjacent items ONLY explore found
precision   = |E ∩ (expected ∪ adjacent ∪ ok)| / |E|   — the noise floor
divergence  = 1 − |E ∩ F| / |E ∪ F|   — anti-collapse (explore ≠ focus)
The gate floors the MEANS. differential is the number that proves explore
earns its existence; adj_mrr is the rank-sensitive twin the demotion
control can move; precision keeps the gates shut to junk; divergence
fails if explore quietly became focus.
gate: measured floors, never tuned to pass. First honest run (2026-09-02,
16 queries, E4 lens offset 0.05 / scale 0.30 / floor 0.80 on the pool-
normalised scale): differential 0.4375/query, adj MRR 0.6111, adj
recall@5 0.506, precision 0.5625, divergence 0.5119. Headroom = one
granularity unit on one query (1/16, 0.5/16, 0.2/16, 0.2/16): one rank
move is churn, a second is a regression. Reference on the same queries:
focus mode precision 0.525, adjacency recall@5 0.498. Pre-E4 (raw-scale
lens): differential 0.5625, adj MRR 0.369, adj recall 0.335, precision
0.322, divergence 0.706 — more explore-only finds, but two thirds of what
it served was noise. Re-baseline only with a lens change the report shows
improving; write the new measured values here when you do.
Controls (same run): first-adjacent-demoted → adj MRR 0.436 (fails), set
metrics unchanged. adjacency weight 0 → differential 0.375 (ON the floor:
loses exactly one find), adj MRR 0.506 + precision 0.381 (fail). Similarity-
only lens → divergence 0.418 (fails) while adj MRR 0.630 / precision 0.562
PASS: similarity + band floor finds the adjacency band by itself; the live
lens's edge is divergence and one extra explore-only find.
